title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-31
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-WE475) -> Sony R500 (Pass Through) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC
taper: Cassettes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard captures a high‑energy New Year’s Eve 1982 show highlighted by Tower of Power horns, an Etta James cameo, and strong first two sets.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard mix that lets the guest horn section and Etta James shine, while the performance delivers a lively first half with Jerry’s guitar soaring. Reviewers note a looser, less compelling third set, but overall the show is remembered as a memorable NYE outing with standout guest jams.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and laud both the music and the crisp soundboard, though a few note a lackluster third set, pulling the average slightly down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with well‑balanced horns and guitar; no dropout or muddiness reported. Reviewers specifically call out the “crisp sound board” of the third set.

poor_songs: Third set (overall – described as loose and abysmal by some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first two sets are tight and energetic, featuring the surprise horn section and guest vocalist; the third set slows down, becoming more laid‑back and less focused.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar is highlighted as “jam‑packed” and praised for tone during the Tower of Power jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s playing on Lovelight is described as okay, with no major complaints.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum work gets a nod in the “playing‑drums‑fade away” sequence, indicating solid percussion throughout.
